title: fix(ai-claude-code): honor chat({ reasoning }) for Claude 5 models

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@tanstack/ai-claude-code': patch
+---
+
+Add the Claude 5 models (`claude-opus-5`, `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-haiku-5-5`, `claude-fable-5`, `claude-fable-5-1`) to the Claude Code reasoning table, so `chat({ reasoning })` is no longer silently ignored for them.

@@ -353,6 +353,7 @@ Do you only need JSON from a prompt, with no repo? Use `@tanstack/ai-anthropic`.
 
 | Model | Reasoning levels | What `reasoning` sets |
 | --- | --- | --- |
+| `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-opus-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-haiku-5-5`, `claude-fable-5-1`, `claude-fable-5` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` | `--effort` |
 | `claude-opus-4-8`, `claude-opus-4-7`, `opus` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` | `--effort` |
 | `claude-opus-4-6`, `claude-sonnet-4-6`, `sonnet` | `low`, `medium`, `high`, `max` | `--effort` |
 | `claude-haiku-4-5`, `haiku` | `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high` | `MAX_THINKING_TOKENS` |

@@ -180,9 +180,9 @@ type ResolveReasoning<TModel extends string> =
     ? ClaudeCodeModelReasoningByName[TModel]
     : never
 
-/** The models that take `--effort`. The same list as the Anthropic adapter's adaptive thinking. */
+/** The models that take `--effort`: Claude 4.6 and later, and the `opus` and `sonnet` aliases. */
 const EFFORT_MODELS =
-  /^(opus|sonnet)$|opus-4-[6-9]|sonnet-4-[6-9]|opus-5|sonnet-5|fable-5/
+  /^(opus|sonnet)$|opus-4-[6-9]|sonnet-4-[6-9]|opus-5|sonnet-5|haiku-5|fable-5/
 
 /**
  * The CLI settings for `chat({ reasoning })`, from the Claude Code docs:

@@ -34,6 +34,13 @@ const EFFORT_LOW_TO_MAX = {
  * `(string & {})` escape hatch in {@link ClaudeCodeModel}.
  */
 export const CLAUDE_CODE_MODELS = [

   'claude-opus-4-6',

 // catalog later. Until then, edit these entries by hand.
 
 const CLAUDE_CODE_REASONING = {

   'claude-opus-4-8': EFFORT_LOW_TO_MAX,
